milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_planks from birch_log results in birch_planks appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 birch_planks (only birch_log and dark_oak_log), so this cannot be a false positive at initialization.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_sign (from 6 dark_oak_planks + 1 stick at a crafting table) results in dark_oak_sign appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 dark_oak_sign, so this cannot be a false positive at initialization.
